description: This file defines types and functions for locating and handling the runtime environment, specifically related to Node.js runtime versions. It includes enums for runtime kind and resolution errors, structs for versioning and resolution details, and a RuntimeLocator with methods to resolve the runtime location and version, with logging and error handling.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Attempts to locate the Node runtime in specified search paths, verifies its version against the minimum required, and returns either success with runtime details or failure with an error.

methods.name: describeFailure
methods.description: Provides a human-readable string describing why runtime resolution failed.

methods.name: findExecutable
methods.description: Searches for an executable with a given name in specified search paths.

methods.name: readVersion
methods.description: Executes the runtime binary with '--version' to read its version string.
